newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, buyers uninterested.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, buyers uninterested.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady on Wednesday morning after a slight rise in IPE futures, but almost no buying was evident, dealers said.

Gasoline barges were steady with physical quotes about 50 cents higher, but June swaps were 50 cents lower. First-half June talk for Eurograde was at around $208/$209 fob Rotterdam. Traders said Tuesday's last deal was at $207.75. Prompt talk was in the region $206/$208.
"The APIs were quite neutral, so we're waiting for direction," one gasoline trader said.
Heating oil barges were also unchanged as IPE gas oil futures barely moved. Offers also remained at IPE June +$2.50 fob Rotterdam, with bids $1 lower.

High sulphur fuel oil traded at $83.25 and $83.50 fob Antwerp. Very prompt Rotterdam material was offered at $82.50. Traders said the lower level was the result of poor prospects for the bunker market for the end of this week.
Later deliveries were offered at $84/$85, as at the close on Tuesday.
